profile.summary: Rising Harte Wellness Center is a community health clinic run by Fred Finch Youth & Family Services on its Oakland campus. It offers medical, dental and audiology services, including immunizations, preventative care and hearing evaluations. Fred Finch is a nonprofit that provides mental health care and family services in California.
